ZBoard is a self-hosted panel for Zero proxy services. This release candidate fixes navigation management and subscription commerce and lifecycle behavior while preserving the existing panel capabilities.

## Changes

- Store administrator, account and public navigation in the database and provide a menu editor. Plugins register their menu entries through the host registry. Hidden native and plugin pages show an unavailable notice on direct access, and hidden plugin pages cannot open sessions.
- Quote plan changes using the lower of the remaining paid time value and remaining traffic value, capped at the target price. Replace the current cycle's quota with the new plan's quota, retain consumed traffic, and preserve the subscription expiry. Show the credit and payable amount before checkout and revalidate the quote when creating and settling the order.
- Add a one-time traffic-reset SKU. A paid reset restores one full base quota without carrying over unused traffic or extending the subscription. Administrators can configure the price and enable the reset operation on the SKU.
- Keep unexpired subscriptions visible after their current-cycle traffic is exhausted. Show the exhaustion state, expiry and next reset time, and provide reset-purchase links from the account overview, subscription list and plan management. Suspend node credentials while traffic is exhausted and restore them after quota recovery.
- Allow administrators to edit current-cycle quota, current-cycle consumed traffic and the quota restored on each reset from subscription details. Preserve original traffic records and log the reason and before/after values. Detect concurrent changes, support retry-safe requests, and update credentials and publication intents in the same transaction.
- Show the latest successful subscription sync time on shared proxy pools, together with the next scheduled sync when automatic sync is enabled. Failed syncs retain the previous success time and valid pool configuration.

## Updating

Use this exact RC image tag rather than the stable `latest` tag. Back up the database, deployment configuration, encryption keys, plugin packages and managed rules before upgrading. Preserve the previous image and the database backup for rollback.

This RC includes migrations `0020_menus` and `0021_order_change_snapshot` for MySQL and SQLite. Run one instance with `-migrate-only`, then start application instances after migration completes. Preserve the existing credential encryption key.

To sell traffic resets, configure a SKU with the traffic-reset entitlement, one-time billing and the reset operation. Set its price in plan administration. Current-cycle quota and the recurring reset quota can be adjusted independently in subscription administration.

Local backend tests and vet, frontend tests, type checking and production builds passed. Browser interactions were checked with mocked API responses; production node synchronization and production database migration were not performed locally. Publication does not deploy the release to an existing site.
